api.clock: required trusted host Callable[[], int], Unix seconds
api.ticket_expiry: deadline for initial activation completion; not lifetime of an already-active session
sample_points: after worker scheduling, before provider call
api.expired_recovery: local terminal revoke with durable lookup/known-session cleanup; never new activation
api.provider_binding: required non-secret trusted host namespace; immutable public property and persistent database match

storage.old_binary_fencing: on reopening only; stop all already-running old processes
storage.migration: explicit offline v3-to-v4 namespace assignment; preserve all seven old tables and spent budgets; v2 must first migrate to v3

deadlines.cleanup_budget: one monotonic budget across the batch and nested provider work

result_custody.historical_active_session: not expired solely by ticket TTL
result_custody.conflicting_known_identity: terminal local revoke and durable cleanup of all owned known identities before raising
result_custody.cross_session_remote_alias: deny the contender and retain its lookup; never revoke the other owner from a mismatched observation
result_custody.same_identity_after_interrupt: stale-generation error without revoking the newer active generation
result_custody.cleanup_adapter_return: only None is the successful trusted adapter contract; false/error payloads remain pending
result_custody.cleanup_summary: jobs/pending/exhausted_pending count both lookup and known-session cleanup; known_* and lookup_* give breakdowns
result_custody.conflict_recovery: no reactivation or automatic reset; exhausted lookup/cleanup remains pending
result_custody.provider_binding_limit: persistent host namespace pin and optional immutable adapter declaration; not remote authentication or credential/account proof

not_provided: authenticated ingress and live identity/session revocation
encrypted metadata and bounded service deployment
claim_ceiling: Local source and regression behavior, not full HG-0087 closure, physical-device or production qualification.

recovery_budget.selection: non-exhausted pending jobs, least reservations used then job ID
recovery_budget.exhausted_work: retained pending; explicit operator escalation, no new activation
recovery_budget.pre_v3_history: uncounted; migration reports unknown historical usage and new allowance
